name: Ivus the Forest Lord

narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer. I will use the power of this charm to augment the magic that has already been gathered. When enough power has been amassed, I shall focus the collected energies and call upon the Forest Lord to aid our cause.
narrative.requestItemsText:
The Frostwolf Clan is protected by a taint of elemental energy. Their shaman meddle in powers that will surely destroy us all if left unchecked.

The damage has grown too great for the Circle to control! Ivus must be called to our aid.

The Frostwolf soldiers carry elemental charms called storm crystals. We can use the charms to conjure Ivus. Venture forth and claim the crystals, adventurer!
